description: Fetch a paper's full body text as Markdown (methods, results, protocols, inline tables) — use for deep questions the abstract can't answer. Accepts a PMC ID (PMC5339222), a bioRxiv/medRxiv DOI (10.1101/…) or an arXiv ID (2401.12345). arXiv full text is available for most Creative Commons papers from May 2024 on; for other arXiv papers it returns the summary view and a link to the full text on arxiv.org.

id.description: arXiv ID, PMC ID, or 10.1101/… DOI.

name: get_full_text
